text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, June 17 - Bombay - No labour problems. Eight vessels loading at berth, 22 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage. 4 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 6 waiting to discharge. 1 Vessel under repair, 2 awaiting orders. Berthing delays expected, containers 1-2 days, bulkers 8-10 days, general cargo 2-3 days. Floating crane laid-up since 5/6 and another floating crane will be laid-up for annual inspection from mid-July for an indefinite period. Calcutta - Eight vessels loading at berth, 26 discharging at berth. 2 Vessels bunkering. 31 Vessels due (5 coking coal, 10 products tankers, 6 containers, 1 crude oil, 2 thermal coal, 1 logs, 1 limestone, 1 sulphur, 1 steel pipes, 1 pig-iron, 2 steel).

Cochin - No labour problems. One vessel loading at berth, 3 vessels waiting at anchor to discharge, 2 under repair/dry-docked (1 at CSL jetty, 1 naval vessel dry-docked). 11 Vessels due with up to 1 day delay expected. Madras - Five vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth. 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge. 39 Vessels due (6 coal, 11 general cargo, 1 fertiliser, 2 barytes, 15 containers, 2 scrap, 1 panamax, 1 other vessel). Delays expected fertiliser/scrap 5-6 days, coal/coke/others 2-3 days, no delays for containers/iron ore. Mormugao - No labour probms. One vessel loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 2 loading at anchor. 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 5 under repair/dry-docked, 1 awaiting court clearance. 10 Vessels due (5 ore, 1 containers, 1 caustic soda, 1 phenol, 1 hsd, 1 phosphoric acid) with following delays expected ore 6-7 days, 1 day delay expected for other vessels.

Kandla - Seven vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 11 discharging in stream. 12 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 3 tankers, 2 vessels under arrest, 10 waiting. 16 Vessels due with 10-12 days delay expected. Mangalore - No labour problems. Seven vessels loading/discharging at berth, 2 awaiting berths, 1 under arrest. 5 Vessels due with 1-2 days delay expected. Heavy continuous rains being experienced. Jawaharlal Nehru - No labour problems. Three vessels discharging at berth (2 fertiliser/raw materials/food grain, 1 tanker/iron ore), 1 iron ore vessel discharging at anchorage. Tanker waiting at anchorage to load, 7 vessels waiting to discharge (5 tankers/iron ore, 2 fertiliser/raw materials/food grain). 3 Vessels due (1 dap, 1 urea, 1 tanker/iron ore) with following delays expected urea 8-10 days, other fertiliser 15-18 days, tankers/iron ore 6 days. Bulk berth 4 will be not be available from 1/7-30/9.

Paradip - No labour problems. Four vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth. 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting to discharge, 2 due with 6-7 days delay expected. Tuticorin - No labour problems. Five vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 6 loading at anchorage, 1 discharging at anchorage. 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 4 due with 1-2 days delay expected. Visakhapatnam - No labour problems. Seven vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth. 17 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth, 11 waiting to load at inner harbour berth, 19 due with 8 days delay expected.

MALAYSIA - Port Kelang - North/south port - Container/ro-ro berths - 8 Vessels berthed, 10 waiting, with 1 day waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharves - 2 Vessels berthed, 2 berthing today, 2 waiting, with 1 day waiting time. Dry/cement bulk terminal - 2 Vessels berthed, 7 waiting. Liquid bulk terminal - 4 Vessels berthed, 2 waiting, with 1 day waiting time. West port - Container/ro/ro berth - 2 Vessels berthed, 1 waiting, with no waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 1 Vessel berthed, none waiting, no delays. Dry/cement bulk terminal - 1 Vessel berthed, none waiting, no delays. Liquid bulk terminal - 1 Vessel berthed, none waiting, no delays.
MAURITIUS, June 17 - Port Louis - Labour working normally. Six vessels berthed (3 containers, 3 general cargo), all discharging/loading. No idle vessels. 1 Vessel dry-docked.

PAKISTAN, June 16 - Karachi - Three vessels loading at berth (clinker, mol), 1 container vessel loading/discharging at berth. 6 Discharging at berth (general cargo, palm oil). 7 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (general cargo, palm oil, jet oil, gasoil, sugar). 2 Vessels awaiting orders. Port Qasim - June 14 - 2 Vessels discharging at berth (palm oil, sugar).

PHILIPPINES, June 14 - Manila - South harbour - The concrete deck structure of pier 15 collapsed on 9/6, rendering 3 berths inoperative (berths 2, 3 and 4). This will result in further congestion at the already congested port.

SOUTH KOREA, June 17 - Inchon - 55 Vessels in port (36 berthed, 19 anchored) of which berthed, 8 general cargo, 5 logs, 3 scrap, 2 coils, 2 pig-iron, 2 containers, 2 soy beans, 1 wire rods, 1 wheat, 1 soy bean meal, 1 raw sugar, 1 molasses, 1 bananas, 1 sorghum, 1 corn, 1 lupins, 1 salt, 1 ply-wood, 1 soy beans. Vessels anchored, 4 corn, 3 containers, 2 general cargo, 1 steel, 1 pig-iron, 1 cars, 1 raw sugar, 1 wheat, 1 logs, 1 steel billets, 1 cables, 1 wire rods, 1 h-beams. Approx. 1 day berthing delay expected. Busan - 151 Vessels in port (46 berthed, 105 anchored) of which berthed, 31 general cargo, 9 containers, 3 scrap, 3 coal. 53 Vessels awaiting berths with approx. 1-2 days delay expected.

Pohang - 26 Vessels in port (24 berthed, 2 anchored) of which berthed and discharging, 6 steel scrap, 2 steel products, 1 iron ore, 1 coal, 1 ferro-silicon. 13 Steel vessels loading. 2 Vessels awaiting berths with approx. 1 days delay expected. Ulsan - 26 Vessels in port (24 berthed, 2 anchored) of which discharging, 2 corn, 1 coke, 1 wood-chips, 1 soda ash, 1 base oil, 1 chemicals, 1 fertiliser, 1 raw sugar, 1 zinc ingots, 1 copper concentrate, 1 petrock, 1 styrene monomer, 1 feed meal. Vessels loading, 3 general cargo, 1 pipes, 1 benzene, 1 styrene monomer, 1 fertiliser, 1 chemicals, 1 diesel oil, 1 zinc ingots. 2 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Masan - Six vessels in port (all berthed) of which discharging, 3 scrap, 1 logs, 1 coke. 1 Vessel loading cigarettes. No berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, June 17 - Colombo - Labour shortage persists. Delays being experienced in berthing/unberthing (pilotage) for break bulk and conventional vessels. 13 Vessels loading at berth (6 essential services, 6 containers, 1 granite). 19 Discharging at berth (1 bagged sugar, 1 bagged flour, 8 containers, 2 essential services, 1 lpg, 1 bulk clinker, 3 general cargo, 1 bulk cement, 1 bagged fertiliser). 6 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (1 container/feeder, 2 bagged cement, 1 bagged sugar, 2 bagged fertiliser). 5 Vessels bunkering, 2 under repair, 1 dry-docked, 6 under arrest, 5 awaiting orders, 1 changing crew. 6 Container vessels due. Delays, general cargo 2-3 days, container/feeders 1 day. Galle - One vessel discharging at berth. Trincomalee - One vessel loading At berth.

TAIWAN, June 16 - Keelung - Four vessels anchored. Berthing delays grain 5 days, coal 9 days, steel 4 days, iron ore 3 days. Kaohsiung - 13 Vessels anchored. Berthing delays grain 7 days, iron/coal 2 days (CSC berth), coal/scrap 7 days (public berth), steel 3 days. Taichung - Five vessels anchored. Berthing delays grain 5-6 days, iron ore/coal/scrap/steel 1 day, others 1-2 days.
THAILAND, June 12 - Bangkok - 80 Vessels in port of which 6 containers, 74 other bulkers and general cargo vessels. 6 Vessels waiting at outer anchorage with 1-2 days berthing delay expected.

TUNISIA, June 14 - Sousse - One vessel loading salt, 1 discharging wood, no vessels waiting, no delays. Sfax - 12 Vessels in port operating of which 7 loading (1 bagged tsp, 1 bulk olive oil cake, 1 bulk rock phosphate, 4 fish). 2 Loading bulk tsp (1 sailing, 1 during berthing). 3 Discharging (1 bulk sulphur, 1 bulk wheat, 1 bulk olive oil/soya. Tunis - One vessel discharging marble chips, 1 general cargo vessel, 3 vessels awaiting instructions. Rades - One vessel discharging sugar, 3 ro/ro's, 1 military vessel. La Goulette - North side - 1 Cereal vessel discharging maize, 1 general cargo vessel, 2 passenger vessels. South side - 1 Vessel discharging grain, no vessels in roads. Gabes - No labour problems. Two vessels loading at berth (1 bulk fertiliser, 1 phosphate). Bizerte - June 17 - No berthing delays/conges
